visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. Current Ponte alle Grazie has five shallow pale concrete arch passages,four unequal warm stone cutwaters and triangular pedestrian overlooks at the paired retained map tips. Connected exterior arch strips avoid internal coplanar slice caps;all five passages are physically open through the complete deck width in every tier. Separate road/raised pavements,curbs,open metal railings,pier lamps,original ashlar relief and paving remain inspectable near. The south-end transverse PMTiles crossing is represented by the source deck and approximate bounded zebra paint;explicit transverse replacement removes its native overlay with the road and paired pavements while preserving connected riverside streets. Exact OSM/Q2517000 outline and named PMTiles road establish the signed north-northeast/south-southwest axis;four paired projecting tips establish asymmetric pier positions. The140.852m envelope is distinct from the rounded150m reference. Five shared256px graphs serve concrete,sandstone,granite,compact-gravel/asphalt approximation and painted metal;traffic paint is palette based. No private or embedded images. Four focused tests prove exact source/tier reconstruction,all five actual apertures,road/pavement continuity,pier tips/native foundation attachment,crosswalk paint and production road/path replacement. All six GLBs validate cleanly. The unmodified129x129/2m global DEM grid oversamples one coarse viewer tile. Bank-edge returns miss the elevated quay crests by about8–9m relative to the reconstructed deck;native fixtures do not certify original urban bank grades or surveyed absolute deck/water elevations. Foundation embedding is checked,not an as-built rail/road approach certificate. The water rectangle is a separate schematic review surface. Small High-mode shallow-member shadow faceting,approximate street furniture/paint/stone pattern and unmeasured physical-device timing remain explicit limitations.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and one ordinary global Terrarium tile;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native field is unmodified. Foundation/abutment embedding is checked. Model datum46m,approximate deck rise9m plus0.2m crown;coarse urban bank returns sit8–9m below the deck,so elevated quay crests/external road grades remain approximate. Shallow arch sections,street furniture,paint and stone pattern are photographic reconstructions. Separate schematic water rectangle is not an exact river polygon or measured water plane.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers;at most six draws;five shared texture graphs and palette traffic paint;no embedded/private images;separate position/normal streams. Source master stays separate. Physical-device timing unmeasured.
